The '''Prefsbelt system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the planet [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. The [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] saw use as a courier and transport in the Prefsbelt system.
